content_sections.heading: GNLU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the GNLU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. rows.event: Walk-in-Interview for Library Stack Assistant/Library Attendant

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GNLU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Gujarat National Law University (GNLU) for filling various library positions on a contractual basis through walk-in interviews.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for various posts including Library Assistant, Library Trainees, and Library Stack Assistant/Library Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for GNLU recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely walk-in. Candidates directly attend the interview at the specified venue along with documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled for 22 October 2026 and 23 October 2026 depending on the specific post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Library Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master of Library & Information Science (MLISc) or Master of Library Science (MLib) with at least 55% marks along with experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Library Trainees?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Library Trainees is 28 years as per the official notification guidelines provided by Gujarat National Law University.

faq.question: Q7. What salary is offered for Library Stack Assistant?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Library Stack Assistant or Library Attendant post will receive a consolidated salary of ₹15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring four copies of their latest resume with a photograph, original documents, and one set of photocopies of academic and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview process conducted by Gujarat National Law University.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job and interview?
faq.answer: The job location and interview venue is Gujarat National Law University located at Attalika Avenue, Knowledge Corridor, Koba, Gandhinagar in Gujarat.
